subject: Biri
text: Biri should only be attacked from a distance, because touching it with a sword electrocutes Link.

evidence.quote: Only attack it from a distance. Even touching it with your sword electrocutes you.

subject: Blue Tektite
text: A Blue Tektite is capable of standing on the surface of water.

evidence.quote: This is a Tektite that's able to stand on the surface of water.

subject: Dark Link
text: Dark Link serves as the mini-boss of the Water Temple and can eventually be defeated by slashing him without targeting.

evidence.quote: Dark Link: MINI-BOSS OF THE WATER TEMPLE...Just slash him without targeting him and he'll eventually go down.

subject: Dead Hand
text: Dead Hand is lured to the surface by getting caught in one of its hands, allowing Link to slash its head when lowered.

evidence.quote: Dead Hand: BOSS OF THE BOTTOM OF THE WELL, MINI-BOSS OF THE SHADOW TEMPLE...Get caught in one of its hands to lure it to the surface, then slash its head when it lowers it.

subject: Deku Baba
text: Killing a Deku Baba by slashing its head always drops Deku Nuts.

evidence.quote: If the Deku Baba is killed by slashes to the head, it always drops Deku Nuts.

subject: Deku Baba
text: Cutting a Deku Baba by its stalk during its non-aggressive state causes it to always drop Deku Sticks.

evidence.quote: If it's cut by the stalk during its non-aggressive state, it will always drop Deku Sticks.

subject: Deku Scrub
text: Deku Scrubs are vulnerable to being slashed after deflecting the Deku Nuts they fire back at them with a shield.

evidence.quote: They can't be sword-slashed up close, so you have to deflect the Nuts it fires by shielding. After getting hit with its own Nut, it runs around, allowing you to slash it to kill it. Some Deku Scrubs tell you important information in an attempt for you to spare them.

subject: Dodongo
text: Dodongos are vulnerable at the tail when hopped behind after their fire breath attack.

evidence.quote: Their weakness is the tail. Wait until they use their fire breath attack, then hop around behind them and slash like crazy.

subject: Dodongo
text: A Dodongo's tail swipe turn-around attack can be blocked using the Deku Shield as Young Link or avoided with a backflip.

evidence.quote: They might swipe their tail to turn around quickly. If so, either use the Deku Shield to block this attack as Young Link, or simply backflip out of the way.

subject: Fire Keese
text: Equipping the Deku Shield should be avoided when Fire Keese ram into Link.

evidence.quote: Don't have the Deku Shield out when they ram into you....

subject: Flare Dancer
text: The Flare Dancer in the Fire Temple must be pulled out of its flaming clothes with the Hookshot before sword slashes can harm it.

evidence.quote: Flare Dancer: MINI-BOSS OF THE FIRE TEMPLE...In order to be able to hit this dude, you have to Hookshot it right out of its flaming clothes. Once it's out, sword slashes will harm it.

subject: Floormaster
text: When hit, a Floormaster splits into three smaller hands that will reassemble if not eliminated quickly.

evidence.quote: If hit, it splits up into three smaller hands. Get rid of the smaller hands quick, or else they'll reassemble.

subject: Freezard
text: Freezards freeze Link upon contact and regenerate body parts unless completely cut down with sword slashes.

evidence.quote: It blows ice cold air at you and if you touch them, you freeze. Slash it with the sword to cut it down until it's completely gone. If you don't get rid of it, it'll regenerate its body parts.

subject: Gerudo Thief
text: Defeating a Gerudo Thief in Gerudo's Fortress always yields a small key to free a carpenter.

evidence.quote: You encounter this kind of enemy frequently in Gerudo's Fortress, mostly when trying to rescue a carpenter...She always drops a small key to free the carpenter from his cell.

subject: Gerudo Thief
text: Being hit by a Gerudo Thief's jumping attack stuns Link and sends him back to his cell.

evidence.quote: If you get hit by her jumping attack, you'll be stunned and be taken back to your cell.

subject: Gold Skulltula
text: There are exactly 100 Gold Skulltulas distinguished by the gold skull-like shell on their back.

evidence.quote: You can tell the difference between them and a normal Skullwalltula by the gold skull-like shell on its back. There are exactly 100 of these critters, and they supposedly hold curses.

subject: Green Bubble
text: Green Bubbles can be killed by waiting until their flames subside before slashing them.

evidence.quote: In order to kill it, wait until its flames subside before slashing it.

subject: Ice Keese
text: Ice Keese freeze Link on contact and can be sniped from afar using the Slingshot or Bow.

evidence.quote: A bat enemy that freezes you on contact. Avoid at all costs. It's easy to just snipe it from afar with the Slingshot or Bow.

subject: Iron Knuckle
text: When fighting an Iron Knuckle as Young Link in the Spirit Temple, using Nayru's Love or throwing bombs helps overcome its tough defense.

evidence.quote: Iron Knuckle: MINI-BOSS OF THE SPIRIT TEMPLE...He's tough when you face him as Young Link, so use either Nayru's Love to protect you, or just throw as many bombs as you have at him.

subject: Keese
text: A Keese transforms into a Fire Keese when exposed to fire, or into an Ice Keese when exposed to blue flame or ice.

evidence.quote: It is highly adaptive to its surroundings, and turns into a Fire Keese when exposed to fire, and an Ice Keese when exposed to blue flame/ice.

subject: Like Like
text: If a Like Like swallows Link and steals equipment, defeating it quickly recovers the stolen items.

evidence.quote: If you let it attack, it will swallow you and possibly steal some of your equipment. Get any stolen equipment back by beating it quickly.

subject: Lizalfos
text: The recommended strategy against Lizalfos is to keep shielded, wait until they strike first, and then execute a jump strike.

evidence.quote: The best strategy for these is to wait until they strike first, then jump striking them. Keep shielded throughout the whole fight and follow this strategy, and they won't stand a chance.

subject: Blue Bubble
text: Blue Bubble: shield so that when they hit you, their flames will go away, and then you can slash 'em.

evidence.quote: Blue Bubble...Just shield so that when they hit you, their flames will go away, and then you can just slash 'em.
